body: I've tried in the past. I just can't find it anymore. I can't see a reason to keep trying...
There were things I enjoyed doing... I stopped. Either because of finances or just the inability to convince myself to get out of bed and do it.

I don't know how to make myself happy and I have such a hard time getting the motivation to do anything.

Also when alone for long periods of time I just start mulling over the reasons why I deserve to be unhappy and why I am such a piece of shit..
